cohort: 30 pregnant women aged 18-35 years with ASA #2 status scheduled for elective LSCS under subarachnoid block
finding: Spinal anaesthesia with 1% 2-Chloroprocaine for LSCS, compared to 0.5% Bupivacaine heavy, provided adequate sensory and motor block without unnecessarily prolonged postoperative stay or serious hemodynamic changes.
